findings.short_summary: Next section opener uses module as subject not student
findings.summary: Forward-looking "## Next" section opens with "Module 6 reads the packaged session" — module is grammatical subject. Rule 28 requires student as subject in forward-looking callouts.
findings.failure_scenario: "Module 6 reads the packaged session. Subtler misses, subtler drift." puts the module/curriculum as the subject describing what happens next, rather than framing it from student perspective (e.g., "You'll find Module 6 reads the packaged session differently").
